items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: my mother sung mostly all French's numbers, French songs.

ctx.x: Well, she sung songs and she sang sacred music, too. But my mother sung mostly all French's numbers, French songs. Yeah. In other words, she couldn't speak 15 words in English.
French, very French. I knew it's a French name that you have. That's right. Were you raised to speak French when you were a boy?
Well, I did. I learned it mostly about her. Of course, my daddy could speak it, too. But not as pure French as my mother could speak French.
